svg.title: AUREL — GT / 01
svg.desc: A detailed original graphite grand touring coupe facing left in a dark photographic studio. Hand-built vector bodywork, blue-black glazing, machined split-spoke wheels, drilled brake rotors, orange calipers, LED lighting, carbon-fiber trim, and layered metallic reflections. No embedded photographs, external assets, or fonts.

g.text: Original automotive concept · Vector studio series
